selectDescription: Choose whether each visit starts a new conversation or resumes an existing one. Prompt, input and context files determine the information supplied for the visit.
Starts a new provider conversation on each visit. Your prompt and selected loop context still apply; earlier provider conversation history is not resumed.
Choose whether each visit starts a new conversation or resumes an existing one. Prompt, input and context files determine the information supplied for the visit.
Resumes the most recent conversation recorded in this run for the same harness, including one used by another node. If none has been recorded, starts fresh.
If a recorded conversation can no longer be resumed, the visit fails with an error instead of silently starting fresh.
